The menu

From the printed card that lies on the table, photographed in the Google listing, prices in euro including all taxes. Everything from the grill and the fryer comes with fresh Cypriot fries. There is also a mini fish meze for 18 euro and house wine by the half litre for 7 euro. Fresh fish for the grill, sea bass, bream, sea bream and white grouper, is sold by weight; those prices were not readable on the photographed page.

From the tables

Photos from the tavern’s own Google listing.

Off the main road since 1983

Pylion stands on the Larnaca to Dhekelia road in the Pyla tourist area, but not on it: the tavern sits a few hundred metres back, quietly next to a park. On the tables are blue and white checked cloths, on the plates grilled octopus, calamari, prawns and whatever the boats brought in. The tavern gives 1983 as its founding year on its own Facebook cover. With 379 Google reviews and 4.3 stars, fish meze and octopus are the words guests use most.

Open every day from twelve noon until half past eleven at night. Eat in, take away or delivery. There is no website, and the tavern’s own entry on Google has not been claimed by anyone.

What guests say

Two of 379 Google reviews, 4.3 stars on average.

“A very good Greek restaurant off the road, quietly next to a park. Incredible, the roughly 250 metres from the main road make the quality. We ordered the Cypriot meze platter for 19 euro and were not disappointed. The various dishes were not served all at once on one platter but one after the other, at our own eating pace. Which was of course thanks to the very attentive and friendly service. The juicy Greek sausages were a highlight. An absolute recommendation, top value for money.”
Nobby Lenz · Google review
“I want to recommend this hidden gem! Definitely worth going! Price are cheaper than the main street restaurants, food is delicious and the portion are enormous! Very kind staff, that made sure that we were having a pleasant experience.”
Adrianna Sz · Google review
